title: The procedure for confirming declared proxies has no branch for an ingress that sends no usable forwarded address
notes: Reading only. An operator declares trustedProxies for an ingress that writes no X-Forwarded-For and follows docs/running.md: 11 wrong sign-ins for an invented name. The doc promises ten 401s and then a refusal with a log line naming the address; they get eleven 401s and no refusal line, and the only hint is a warning written once per process, which the same paragraph's 'a single failed sign-in writes no log line' contradicts. They cannot tell a working bound from an absent one. With BL-210, BL-213, BL-216 and BL-218 this is one operator experience: declaring proxies and knowing it worked. Product owner: amend JS-056 with a criterion that the confirmation procedure, followed against the example manifests' ingress, says what the operator sees and does when no address is counted; mark this promoted once tasks/prd.json carries it. Promote ahead of JS-056 if an operator reports following the procedure and being unable to tell.
